katas.title: Problem details: always show the real exception message so support can debug

seededDefectKey.scenario: A storage or serialization bug throws an unexpected exception (e.g. a NullReferenceException, a SqlException with a connection string or table name in its text).
seededDefectKey.consequence: The 500 arm now sends the raw exception message as problem.detail, and the client renders problem.detail verbatim (api.ts:37-38): internals reach every user. The server-side LogError line was deleted with it, so the real error is no longer logged either.

seededDefectKey.scenario: The shipped handler has the same leak.
seededDefectKey.consequence: Review F4: the patch reverts the fix to the reviewed defect.
